metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity among sampled nonpadding item embeddings, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. About 0.5 indicates zero mean cosine; higher values indicate directional alignment, not demonstrated recommendation diversity loss or observed user preferences. Null with fewer than two sampled items or any sampled nonfinite or zero-norm embedding.
metric_definitions.embedding_invalid_count: Number of sampled nonpadding embeddings with nonfinite coordinates, nonfinite L2 norm, or zero L2 norm. Zero when fewer than two items were sampled and alignment was not attempted.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_training_frequency_breakd: At most ten training batches with dropout disabled. Only nonpadding sequence, positive and negative positions with finite logits enter margins. Reports batch counts, excluded nonfinite positions, and valid-position denominators. Bucket counts use only training interactions: 0, 1..5, 6..20, >=21; repeated occurrences count separately. Positive bucket denominators cover all finite valid positions; low-margin and wrong-rank counts are subsets. Dataset name is the adapter's route when exposed, otherwise null. Residual logit means average absolute positive and negative logits over residual_logit_positions; the residual is augmented logits minus backbone logits, with no second addition. Ratio is the ratio of these absolute means, null without observations or with zero base magnitude. These are training probes, not validation HR estimates. Metadata categories, review content and simulator traits are unavailable.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of nonpadding catalog embeddings sampled with local seed 42.
metric_definitions.item_norm_log_training_frequency_pearson: Pearson correlation between item embedding L2 norm and log1p(training interaction count) across finite nonpadding catalog embeddings. Null for insufficient items or zero variance; association does not establish causation.
metric_definitions.item_norm_frequency_items: Number of finite item norms entering the frequency association.
